class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/Mujoco3dLidarPlugin
class.description: Publishes single-row mujoco.plugin.lidar sensor data as sensor_msgs/LaserScan and multi-row sensor data as sensor_msgs/PointCloud2.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/StateCapturePlugin
class.description: Captures simulation time and qpos into a bounded real-time-safe ring buffer and periodically writes the samples to a CSV file from a consumer thread.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control_plugins/SimulationManagementPlugin
class.description: Provides services for inspecting and managing the simulation, including a thread-safe state service and an mjSpec-based service for resizing and moving a managed floor box.
